name: email_term_end_cancellation_draft_reply
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Agent reviews email thread th_b03_cancel_term_end, reads renewal terms, and drafts a reply with exact end date
tests: Drafts email reply for term-end cancellation request citing exact term end date from renewal records
instruction:
You are Kendra Price, a billing operations coordinator at Cloudnest (User ID: U_OPS1). You are reviewing the incoming billing queue.

Please ask the billing desk assistant to check email thread th_b03_cancel_term_end sent by Karen Kite (KiteWorks, T11), check their renewal terms, and prepare an email draft in reply confirming that their cancellation will be effective at the end of their current term on 2026-11-01 and that they will retain full access until then.

Your details:
- Customer Name: Karen Kite
- Customer Email: karen@kiteworks.com
- Tenant ID: T11 (KiteWorks)
- Your User ID: U_OPS1
- Thread ID: th_b03_cancel_term_end
- Initial Message ID: bmsg_005

persona.name: Kendra Price
persona.initial_message: Please check email thread th_b03_cancel_term_end from Karen Kite requesting term-end cancellation, check KiteWorks renewal terms, and draft a reply confirming access continues until term end.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in

arguments.body: Hi Karen, We have reviewed your request. KiteWorks subscription is set to end at the conclusion of your current term on 2026-11-01. You will retain full access to all features and entitlements until that date.
arguments.subject: Re: Cancel at the end of our term
